# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues. Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cboone/board/security/advisories/new) instead.

Include a description, reproduction steps, potential impact, and any suggested mitigation. Board's security-sensitive areas include authentication, authorization, session handling, encrypted token storage, model input handling, cross-site scripting, and cross-site request forgery.

## Scope

Report vulnerabilities in Board itself. Report vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies to their maintainers as well.
